subject: Next steps: private hosting technical review & demo — calendar options and pre-call asks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Gordon <agordon@carelane.health>, Priya Menon <priya.m@carelane.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: private hosting technical review & demo — calendar options and pre-call asks

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for your time today — great discovery call. To keep momentum, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute architecture review + demo focused on Private (VPC) deployment and ops/readiness for a proof-of-concept. High-level goals for the session:

- Walk through CareLane's network and security constraints so we can validate a VPC deployment topology
- Demo the Private control plane and routing/fallback behavior for on-prem flows
- Surface any access prerequisites (KMS, peering/VPN, firewall rules) and list next steps for an ops runbook

Proposed slots (I included timezone translations below — please pick two that work and we'll lock one):
- Wed Apr 28: 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Wed Apr 28: 15:00–16:00 PT / 18:00–19:00 ET
- Thu Apr 29: 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET

Prep items we need ahead of the call (will make the session < 60 mins):
1) A brief network diagram or list of CIDR ranges and whether you plan to use VPN or Direct Connect (attach as a PDF or text)
2) Name and email of your security lead for the follow-up (we'll include them on the runbook review)
3) Any contractual/data residency/KMS requirements to surface to our solutions architect

I've attached a short kickstart agenda and a one-page pre-call checklist. Marissa / Connor — if either of you want to add or adjust the agenda, please do.

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood_priv_onprem_kickstart_agenda.pdf, precall-network-checklist.xlsx

Jonas — thanks, that structure looks good.

We can do Wed Apr 28 at 15:00 PT. I'll loop in our Infrastructure lead, Maya Iqbal (maya.iqbal@carelane.health), and our Security manager, Tom Reyes (tom.reyes@carelane.health). They both should be available for the later slot.

I'll attach a basic network snippet (mostly NAT + CIDR ranges) in a follow-up — want to keep anything sensitive off email so we'll share via your secure upload link. Also, we require HSM-backed KMS for production; for the PoC we can use a customer-managed key in our dev tenant.

— Alex
